verdict.rationale: Remote inspection of live topics, logs, and state on a deployed robot is a fair question for a robotics platform that deploys ROS 2 stacks to Jetson. However, the evidence only covers simulation, training, ROS 2 bridging, and GPU-accelerated ROS packages, with no remote debugging or monitoring tooling. Isaac TeleOp appears only as a source of real-world data captured for conversion to USD, not as a way to monitor robots.
